gloss: anyway; in any case; at any rate

definitions.gloss: anyway; in any case; at any rate
definitions.explanation: Used to shift focus or move on to the main point, regardless of what was discussed before.

examples.japanese: ともあれ、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧みよう。
⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ともあれ、⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Whatever the reason, the result was good.

examples.japanese: ともあれ、⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧だ。
examples.english: At any rate, I'm glad you're safe.

notes:
ともあれ is used to set aside previous discussion and move on to the main point or a more important topic. It means 'anyway,' 'in any case,' or 'be that as it may.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ともあれ、〜 (at sentence start: 'anyway, ...')
- X⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ともあれ (setting X aside: 'whatever X may be, ...')
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ともあれ (whatever happens, first of all — a common set phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とにかく→とにかく：03464_tonikaku⟧: anyway (more casual, emphatic, very common)
- ⟦いずれにせよ→いずれにせよ：06779_izureniseyo⟧: in any case (more formal)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さておき: setting that aside (conversational)
- ⟦ともかく→ともかく：06780_tomokaku⟧: anyway (similar to ともあれ, slightly more casual)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in both written and spoken Japanese, but ⟦とにかく→とにかく：03464_tonikaku⟧ is far more frequent in casual speech.
